repo_notes.content: MAS-PromptBench is a benchmark for system-prompt optimization in multi-agent LLM systems. It runs real multi-agent runners on 9 tasks, 5 workflow topologies (single, independent, sequential, centralized, decentralized) implemented in LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen and the OpenAI Agents SDK, 3 communication formats (freeform, semi_structured, structured_soft), team sizes 2/4/8/10 and two task models (Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B, meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct). Eight prompt optimizers (GEPA, MIPRO, MAPRO, MASPO, HiveMind, MAMUT-GEPA, MASPOB, TAVO), one package each under optimizers/, share one run protocol (mas-promptbench-v1, optimizers/protocol) and one real-runner bridge (optimizers/bridge). The gain is the deployed minus the seed-prompt score on the held-out test split, paired over optimizer seeds 0, 1 and 2. Shared runner code lives in core/. The hosted tutorial is at https://fm8995610-ops.github.io/MAS-PromptBench/docs/ and its source in docs/content/.
repo_notes.author: Maintainers

repo_notes.content: Gotchas to state wherever relevant: (1) run every module with python -m from the repo root, e.g. python -m topologies.single.hotpotqa.langgraph_hotpotqa; the file-path form fails with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'core'. (2) Every runner shares core/cli.py: --batch, --limit, --offset, --only, --out-dir, --out plus dataset options; the BFCL, SWE-bench, API-Bank, ToolHop and communication runners run a batch even without --batch; ToolHop needs TOOLHOP_ALLOW_DATASET_EXEC=1. (3) Optimizer results come only from python -m optimizers.protocol.run (one job = method, cell, optimizer seed) and python -m optimizers.protocol.aggregate; there are no standalone optimizer scripts. Set TASK_ENDPOINTS (fallback VLLM_BASE_URL) and REFLECTION_MODEL_BASE_URL (default http://localhost:8200/v1). (4) A --budget other than 600, an off-grid cell (--allow-any-cell) or another REFLECTION_MODEL_ID makes a job non-conformant; aggregate skips it unless --include-nonconformant. (5) The protocol scores LiveCodeBench and APPS on the first 3 tests and SWE-bench with a structural diff check, cheaper than the runners' scorers. (6) The agent frameworks are pinned upstream commits in environment.yml (no submodules); the OpenAI Agents SDK needs openai>=3 and is installed with pip install --target vendor/openai_agents -r requirements-openai-agents.txt. (7) Fixed splits are benchmarks/<dataset>/<dataset>_splits.json; their test split is the evaluation-ID set.

pages.title: Overview

pages.title: Installation and Model Setup
pages.purpose: The conda environment with pinned LangGraph, CrewAI and AutoGen commits, the isolated OpenAI Agents SDK install in vendor/openai_agents, connecting an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and serving Qwen3.5-9B, Llama-3.1-8B and the Qwen3.5-122B reflection model with the scripts in models/.

pages.title: Quick Start
pages.purpose: Running a baseline runner, one optimizer job with optimizers.protocol.run and the seed aggregation, with correct module-form commands.

pages.title: Repository Architecture
pages.purpose: The layers (benchmarks, configs, core, runners, bridge, protocol, methods), the core/ modules, and the flow of one task through a runner and of one optimizer job through the run protocol.

pages.title: Tasks
pages.purpose: The nine datasets, their task modules in core/tasks/, evaluation IDs and fixed splits in benchmarks/, scorers and dataset command-line options.

pages.title: Reasoning Tasks
pages.purpose: GPQA-Diamond, HotpotQA (Wikipedia retrieval) and MATH (Precalculus, Level 5): data, output contracts and scoring.

pages.title: Coding Tasks
pages.purpose: LiveCodeBench, APPS and SWE-bench Verified: code execution, test caps, --eval modes, the SWE-bench Singularity sandbox and patch scoring.

pages.title: Tool-Calling Tasks
pages.purpose: BFCL (AST checker, --category), ToolHop (dataset tools, TOOLHOP_ALLOW_DATASET_EXEC) and API-Bank (levels, ToolSearcher scoring).

pages.title: Workflow Topologies
pages.purpose: How the five topologies route work, the framework x topology matrix, the thin runners on top of core/ and their module paths.

pages.title: Single and Independent
pages.purpose: The single ReAct agent and the independent ensemble with its gold-free majority vote.

pages.title: Sequential
pages.purpose: The staged pipeline in LangGraph and CrewAI, its roles and context passing.

pages.title: Centralized
pages.purpose: Manager and workers in LangGraph and AutoGen SelectorGroupChat, delegation tools, termination and turn caps.

pages.title: Decentralized
pages.purpose: Multi-agent debate in LangGraph and the OpenAI Agents SDK (topologies/decentralized/openai_agents), rounds and final-round voting.

pages.title: Communication Protocols
pages.purpose: The freeform, semi_structured and structured_soft message formats (core/communication.py, communications/), how they are applied and run.

pages.title: Team Sizes
pages.purpose: The teamsizes/ runners for r = 2, 4, 8, 10 (core.variant), the team specs in configs/teams/, and explicit output paths.

pages.title: Optimizers
pages.purpose: The eight methods (GEPA, MIPRO, MAPRO, MASPO, HiveMind, MAMUT-GEPA, MASPOB, TAVO), one package each with integration.py, their grid coverage and settings, and how they share the run protocol and the real-runner bridge.

pages.title: Run Protocol and Bridge
pages.purpose: optimizers/protocol (mas-promptbench-v1: job phases, 600-rollout budget, strictly-better selection, held-out test, method registry and identity) and optimizers/bridge (adapters, registry keys, DSPy programs, dataset loaders and metrics, templates, adding a pair).

pages.title: Running and Aggregating Jobs
pages.purpose: Endpoints (TASK_ENDPOINTS, REFLECTION_MODEL_BASE_URL), choosing a cell with --topology and registry keys, --phase and resuming, smoke budgets, running seeds 0-2 and optimizers.protocol.aggregate.

pages.title: Evaluation Protocol
pages.purpose: Evaluation IDs, fixed train/validation/test splits, budget charging, decoding and request seeds, selection, protocol metrics versus runner scorers, output contracts and telemetry.

pages.title: Run Outputs
pages.purpose: Protocol job artifacts (job.json, optimization/, optimization.json, evaluations/, selection.json, test.json, result.json), fallback reasons, the aggregate summary and the runners' predictions JSONL.

pages.title: Configs and Seed Prompts
pages.purpose: configs/prompts layout, roles.yaml, domains.yaml, tools.yaml, how generate_role_prompts.py writes the role prompts, and the team specs in configs/teams/.

pages.title: Extending the Benchmark
pages.purpose: Adding a dataset (task module, team spec, runners, splits, bridge loader), a topology or framework variant (runners, adapters, registry), and an optimizer method (integration.py, METHODS registry).

pages.title: Tests
pages.purpose: Unit tests in tests/core and core/tasks/tests, the optimizer tests with fakes, and the golden behavior snapshots in tests/golden replayed against a local fake model server.

pages.title: Command-Line and Environment Reference
pages.purpose: Every runner, run-protocol, aggregate, prompt-generator and golden-recorder option, and every environment variable read by the runners, the protocol, the bridge, the methods, the sweeps and the serve scripts.
